system.description: Characters defined by breadth and versatility rather than a single overwhelming specialty. They keep several strong options ready and adapt to what the situation requires. Unlocks no restricted skill. May only be selected at character creation.
system.benefit: Whenever you gain a pip in a Combat Skill, also gain one Action Card of that Rank or lower for that Combat Skill.

origin.name: Broad Reserves
origin.text: Increase your maximum Stamina, Focus, and Mana by 5 each.
